opening.argument: The presentation promotes BitClub Network as a paid business opportunity, requiring a $99 license and mining machine while tying compensation to affiliate registration, billing points, and team members’ binary cycles. Its structure organizes successive recruits into levels: “Your two first Dirts will be catalogued as Team 1. Your third, fourth and fifth Dirt will be categorized as Equipment 1.” It also links earnings to “mining machines that sell in your structure” and presents progressively priced machine options, including $500, $1,000, and $2,000 choices. Viewers are encouraged to recruit clients and distribute presentations to reach fees and ranks through tiered machine-sale commissions. The speaker further claims that reinvesting mined proceeds can produce five to six times more mining, but the material does not verify mining performance, payouts, or participant outcomes.
